# Jacob Shope Mortgage

Jacob Shope is a Mortgage Loan Officer with Mpire Financial, NMLS# 2090979. The website focuses on mortgage and real-estate-financing education for Charlotte, Huntersville, Cornelius, Davidson, Lake Norman, Mooresville, and surrounding communities.
